dct_description_sm: We collect information about physical and chemical parameters of water masses, as well as the composition of the benthic and demersal fish communities occurring in Greenland waters to assess the climate change effects on these fishes abundance and distribution. Fisheries survey cruises are also conducted on the west coast of Greenland to determine the impact of fisheries on the demersal fish community.  This dataset is produced within the framework of the program Nuuk Basic (www.nuuk-basic.dk), which is coordinated with another monitoring program Zackenberg Basic (www.zackenberg.dk). These two programs are extensive cross-disciplinary ecological studies that examine the effect of climate change and variability on terrestrial and marine ecosystems.
dct_title_s: Benthic and demersal fish stocks in west Greenland
